name: lang-bridge
description: LangMode: type in RU/UK/ES/AR, the model reads English, replies are drawn translated back (TranslateGemma service).

lang.title: Display language
lang.description: auto: replies follow the language of the last prompt. Or a fixed code: ru, uk, es, ar, en.

url.title: Translation service
url.description: OpenAI-compatible chat/completions endpoint serving translategemma-12b. Empty turns the mod off.

timeoutSec.title: Timeout per chunk, seconds
timeoutSec.description: A chunk not translated in time is shown (or sent) in the original.
